regime: Gold short-term downtrend and silver under extra stress, with a December Fed hike almost fully priced
takeaway: Gold slipped about 1% overnight to near $3,845, its lowest since October 2025 and about 7.7% below a month ago, while silver fell more (about 2.3% to near $47.50), pushing the gold/silver ratio near 81. Markets put the odds of a December Fed hike above 90% and the dollar sits near a 19-month high, though Treasury yields eased slightly ahead of Fed Chair Warsh's speech today. Tech is set to open weaker, with Nasdaq-100 futures down about 1% as Nvidia slips ahead of its results on Tuesday.
